_comment: Curated Hodinkee articles for the editorial corpus. Hodinkee publishes a huge amount of new-watch content; this list captures the OCCASIONAL vintage-relevant piece Mark wants in the corpus — a complement to the existing Bring a Loupe / Reference Points scrapers (which target specific columns, not general /articles/...). To add an article: paste the full URL into the `urls` array; the scraper picks it up on the next cron run. URLs are matched by exact string; old/new can coexist.
